name: 4-METHYLAMINOREX
summary: A very potent stimulant that has a long duration of action at around 16 hours.

pharmacology.text: 4-MAR acts as a highly potent monoamine releasing agent (MRA). It is specifically a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) with weak effects on serotonin. The drug's EC50 values for induction of monoamine neurotransmitter release have been found to be 4.8 nM for norepinephrine, 1.7 nM for dopamine, and 53.2 nM for serotonin. It is among the most potent and selective dopamine releasing agents (DRAs) known.

uses.text: It is also known by its street name "U4Euh" ("Euphoria").

summaryZh: 4-甲基阿米雷司，分子式C10H12N2O，是一種興奮劑，帶有噁唑啉基團，由McNeil實驗室在1960年代開發。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, long-lasting insomnia, loss of appetite, anxiety and paranoia. Serious risks include heart problems, psychosis and dependence. Drugs of the aminorex family have been linked to pulmonary hypertension, a serious lung condition.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、持續很久的失眠、食慾不振、焦慮與多疑。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、精神病與成癮。阿米雷司家族的藥物曾與肺動脈高壓這種嚴重的肺部疾病有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、持续很久的失眠、食欲不振、焦虑与多疑。严重风险包括心脏问题、精神病与成瘾。阿米雷司家族的药物曾与肺动脉高压这种严重的肺部疾病有关。

fact.en: It was first made in the 1960s during a search for new appetite suppressants. Its street name U4Euh is a play on the word euphoria.
fact.zh: 它最早是在1960年代尋找新型食慾抑制劑時合成的。它的街頭名稱「U4Euh」是英文「euphoria」（欣快感）的諧音。
fact.zhHans: 它最早是在1960年代寻找新型食欲抑制剂时合成的。它的街头名称「U4Euh」是英文「euphoria」（欣快感）的谐音。
